description: Residual of FIND-006. When the paid-user list is empty (users=[]) AND loops are off, the sweeper still issues step.sendEvent('fan', []) with an empty events array (functions.js:59-62 wake; 74-77 travel; 89-92 ask). The empty-list test (inngest.test.js:223-239) uses a fakeStep stub and only asserts 'no non-empty fan-outs' — it never exercises step.sendEvent('') against the REAL inngest SDK, so whether the SDK treats an empty batch as a harmless no-op or throws is untested. A real-SDK or guarded path (skip sendEvent when users.length===0) would close this. Low severity because an empty fan-out is benign in practice, but it is an unverified edge against the actual dependency.
